make_or_buy_basis: Supplier-qualified roof-module laminate consumables, EPDM seal stock, trim materials, and removable skirt blanks feed the local mould/trim/clip process.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: UV-stable roof finish, sealed cut edges, ozone-resistant EPDM, and galvanic isolation at retained hardware
material_spec.form_factor: kitted roof-module reinforcement/core/resin/finish consumables, extruded EPDM seals, skirt blanks, trim stock, and coupon material
material_spec.governing_standard: supplier laminate and seal certificates plus project EN 45545, ozone/UV, ingress, and LM3-BDY-160 mould-process evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: fire-rated roof-module laminate consumables, EPDM dry-seal stock, removable skirt blanks, and retained-fastener consumables
material_spec.material_family: supplier-qualified exterior GFRP roof-module and seal material pack
material_spec.nominal_section: supports 1,000 mm roof-module mould pitch, dry joints, drain paths, removable skirts, and anti-lift/clip hardware interfaces
material_spec.traceability: laminate batch, seal batch, cure/coupon trace, service-removal record, and water-test record

joining_methods: sealed, gasketed, bonded, or clipped interface as supplier envelope requires
process_spec.release_level: BID supplier-controlled process; OSR controls envelope and acceptance evidence

fit_gaps: No public product family alone establishes the complete LM3 rail fire/structural laminate; formulation and process qualification remain open.
supplier_anchor.localisation: Resin, reinforcement, core and coating may be sourced locally only as a qualified laminate system with coupon, fire, weathering, insert and full-module evidence.
mandatory_equivalence: same or better released fit, mounting datums, connector keying and service envelope
same or better mass, load, duty-cycle, thermal, electrical and environmental ratings
same or better functional safety, fire, EMC, cybersecurity and applicable rail evidence
documented failure modes, maintenance intervals, spares and obsolescence route
first-article inspection plus component, subassembly and vehicle regression tests
signed design-authority substitution record preserving the original anchor and evidence hashes
supplier_anchor.product_family: fire-retardant composite laminating and core materials
supplier_anchor.release_boundary: A web page is not a purchase specification. Design authority must freeze the exact supplier part number, configuration, drawings, software, evidence, commercial terms and spares through RFQ before release. Safety-critical substitutes require calculation, test, independent assessment and authority acceptance.
